description: Compute monthly churn rates per subscription start cohort. The cohort is the calendar month of start_date. For each cohort and month_offset (0 = cohort month), up to the latest calendar month present in the data (max of start_date and cancel_date): active_at_start = subscriptions of the cohort that are active at the beginning of that month (for offset 0: all subscriptions of the cohort; for later offsets: cancel_date IS NULL or cancel_date >= first day of the month); churned = subscriptions of the cohort whose cancel_date falls in that month; churn_rate = churned / active_at_start. Output columns: cohort_month (DATE), month_offset (INT64), active_at_start (INT64), churned (INT64), churn_rate (FLOAT64, 4 decimals).

cancel_date.description: Date the subscription was cancelled; NULL if active

edge_cases: Subscription 3 starts and cancels within the cohort month (churn at offset 0)
Subscription 4 cancels on the first day of March: it is active at the start of March and churns in March
Active subscriptions with NULL cancel_date remain in every denominator
The denominator shrinks each month; it is not the original cohort size
common_failure_modes: FM3: Dividing by the original cohort size for every offset understates later churn rates
FM2: Using cancel_date > month_start excludes subscriptions cancelled on the first day from the active base
FM5: cancel_date >= month_start evaluates to NULL for active subscriptions and removes them from the base
